author: root

senses.definition: not able to do something
senses.example: He was incapable of answering the question.

reviewNotes: incapable of 表达无法做某事；中文改成能力不足，不误解为物理上不可能。

author: root

senses.definition: extremely large
senses.example: A gigantic tree stood by the river.

reviewNotes: gigantic 是程度很强的巨大；树木例句与建筑搭配自然。

author: root

senses.zh: 全部表演曲目；技能储备
senses.definition: all pieces a performer can play or skills someone can use
senses.example: The pianist added a new piece to her repertoire.

reviewNotes: repertoire 兼顾演出曲目及个人技能库；钢琴例句对应演艺义。

author: root

senses.definition: to examine something very carefully
senses.example: The team scrutinized every line of the report.

reviewNotes: scrutinize 是细致审视而非普通浏览；逐行检查报告合适。

author: root

senses.definition: remaining after most has gone
senses.example: A residual smell remained in the room.

senses.definition: a quantity or part that remains
senses.example: The model showed a small residual.
senses.note: 名词多见于统计、财务等专业语境。

reviewNotes: residual 形容词常指剩余价值/效应；名词为剩余量，统计语境可用。

author: root

senses.definition: a heavy metal used as fuel in some nuclear reactors
senses.example: The country has uranium deposits.

reviewNotes: uranium 是元素铀；核反应堆燃料解释及矿藏例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: An occasion when an employer stops giving someone work because fewer workers are needed.
senses.example: The factory announced another layoff.

reviewNotes: layoff 是雇主裁员或暂时停工，不泛指任何失业；定义已收紧。

author: root

senses.definition: something that causes great surprise or admiration
senses.example: The bridge is a marvel of engineering.

senses.definition: to feel great surprise or admiration
senses.example: We marvelled at the night sky.

reviewNotes: marvel 名词是令人赞叹之物，动词常与 at 连用；双词性保留。

author: root

senses.definition: a person who makes or alters clothes to fit
senses.example: The tailor shortened the sleeves.

senses.definition: to change something to fit a need
senses.example: The lessons were tailored to each child.

reviewNotes: tailor 人与按需调整的动词均常用；tailored to 例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: made from clay hardened by heat
senses.example: She bought a ceramic bowl.

senses.definition: a thing made from heated clay or similar material
senses.example: The museum displayed colourful ceramics.

reviewNotes: ceramic 形容词与名词均常见；陶瓷碗和陶瓷制品已区分。

author: root

senses.definition: with great force or in an aggressive way
senses.example: The door shook violently in the wind.

reviewNotes: violently 可指暴力也可指物体猛烈运动；风吹门例句属后者。

author: root

senses.definition: to become lighter or make someone happier
senses.example: Her smile brightened the room.

reviewNotes: brighten 同时可指增亮及使心情好转；笑容例句属比喻用法。

author: root

senses.definition: To meet for a formal discussion, or to call people together for such a meeting.
senses.example: The committee will convene on Friday.

reviewNotes: convene 既可召集会议也可由会议成员聚集；改定义覆盖不及物例句。

author: root

senses.definition: the number 19
senses.example: She was nineteen when she started university.

reviewNotes: nineteen 数词及年龄例句对应，未附会其他义项。

author: root

senses.definition: a line in skin or cloth or an unexpected problem
senses.example: There is a small wrinkle in the shirt.

senses.definition: to form lines or folds
senses.example: The shirt wrinkles easily.

reviewNotes: wrinkle 皮肤/布料皱纹为主，小问题和动词用法同属常用义。

author: root

senses.definition: in the middle of or included in a group
senses.example: She felt relaxed amongst friends.
senses.note: amongst 与 among 意思相近；among 更常用。

reviewNotes: amongst 与 among 同义，英式风格较明显；朋友中例句合适。

author: root

senses.definition: To calculate a result, often with a computer.
senses.example: The program computes the total automatically.

reviewNotes: compute 指计算结果，不限于数字；已放宽英文定义。

author: root

senses.definition: the ability to understand
senses.example: This exercise tests reading comprehension.

reviewNotes: comprehension 是理解能力；reading comprehension 是高频搭配。

author: root

senses.definition: to strongly hope to achieve something
senses.example: She aspires to become a teacher.

reviewNotes: aspire 通常接 to/to be，表达追求目标；教师例句匹配。

author: root

senses.zh: 规格；技术要求；详细说明
senses.definition: a detailed statement of what a product or work must do
senses.example: Please check the laptop's specifications.

reviewNotes: specification 是产品的详细要求或规格；复数 specs 语境自然。

author: root

senses.definition: a round nut with a hard shell or the wood of its tree
senses.example: She added walnuts to the cake.

reviewNotes: walnut 核桃果实与核桃木均为普通名词义；烘焙例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: a structure over water or a support under a bridge
senses.example: The boat stopped at the pier.

reviewNotes: pier 可为水上栈桥也可为桥墩；船靠码头示主用法。

author: root

senses.definition: a silver-coloured metal or a US coin worth five cents
senses.example: The coin contains nickel.

reviewNotes: nickel 包含金属镍及美式五美分硬币；元素例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: the area of mathematics about shapes and space
senses.example: The class studied triangles in geometry.

reviewNotes: geometry 对形状和空间的数学研究，三角形例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: in the best possible situation
senses.example: Ideally, we should leave before eight.

reviewNotes: ideally 有理想情况下和最恰当地的用法；保留 ideally suited 搭配。

author: root

senses.definition: a failure to obey a rule or a gap in a barrier
senses.example: The leak was a serious breach of privacy.

senses.definition: to break a rule or make a gap in a barrier
senses.example: The company breached the agreement.

reviewNotes: breach 名词/动词均指违反，也可指防线缺口；隐私泄露例句合适。

author: root

senses.definition: a round handle used to open or control something
senses.example: Turn the knob to lower the heat.

reviewNotes: knob 是圆形旋钮或门把；调低热量的例句匹配。

author: root

senses.definition: a piece of medicine, a flat computer, or a flat piece of stone
senses.example: She uses a tablet to read books.

evidence.note: Dictionary lists medicine, computer, and hard block.

reviewNotes: tablet 药片、平板电脑、石板均常见；电子阅读例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: to bend the knees and sit low
senses.example: He squatted down to tie his shoe.

senses.definition: a position or exercise with bent knees
senses.example: She did ten squats before running.

senses.definition: short and wide in shape
senses.example: A squat building stood at the corner.

reviewNotes: squat 动词蹲下、名词深蹲、形容词矮宽均不同；逐义保留。

author: root

senses.definition: to change from liquid into gas or disappear
senses.example: The water evaporated in the sun.

reviewNotes: evaporate 蒸发也可比喻消失；水在日光下蒸发准确。

author: root

senses.definition: the number 70
senses.example: My grandfather turned seventy this year.

reviewNotes: seventy 仅数词七十；年龄例句直接。

author: root

senses.definition: giving off energy from unstable atoms
senses.example: Radioactive waste must be stored safely.

reviewNotes: radioactive 指不稳定原子产生辐射，废料搭配常见。

author: root

senses.definition: to model a real situation or pretend
senses.example: The software simulates a flight.

reviewNotes: simulate 表示模拟真实情况，也可假装；飞行软件例句正确。

author: root

senses.definition: a game where teams hit a ball over a net
senses.example: We play volleyball after school.

reviewNotes: volleyball 可指排球运动，结合 play 搭配；未混为球拍运动。

author: root

senses.definition: to make someone curious or interested
senses.example: The title of the book intrigued me.

senses.definition: secret plans or a sense of mystery
senses.example: The film is full of political intrigue.

reviewNotes: intrigue 动词激起兴趣，名词阴谋或神秘感；电影政治阴谋例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: things being in a line or plans being in agreement
senses.example: Check the alignment of the text.

reviewNotes: alignment 是排成一线或方向一致；改去误导性的队列译法。

author: root

senses.definition: to close one eye briefly as a signal
senses.example: She winked at her friend.

senses.definition: a quick closing of one eye as a signal
senses.example: He gave us a wink.

reviewNotes: wink 眨一眼可示意；动作与名词眼色均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: rough, made of large pieces, or rude
senses.example: The sand felt coarse under her feet.

reviewNotes: coarse 可指粗粒、粗糙或言语粗俗；沙粒例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: the way a word is written with letters
senses.example: Check the spelling of each new word.

reviewNotes: spelling 是单词字母写法；拼写错误搭配自然。

author: root

senses.zh: 催化剂；促成变化的事物
senses.definition: a substance that speeds a reaction or something that causes change
senses.example: The meeting was a catalyst for change.

reviewNotes: catalyst 化学催化剂与变化诱因并用；会议促成变化例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: a tall piece of furniture for clothes or all someone's clothes
senses.example: Her coat is in the wardrobe.

reviewNotes: wardrobe 衣柜与个人全部衣物均常见；外套例句示家具义。

author: root

senses.definition: thick oil or fat used for cooking or moving parts
senses.example: There was grease on the pan.

senses.definition: to put grease or oil on something
senses.example: Grease the baking tray before using it.

reviewNotes: grease 名词油脂与动词涂油均常用；烤盘例句对应动词。

author: root

senses.definition: the business and activity of flying aircraft
senses.example: She wants to work in aviation.

reviewNotes: aviation 是航空活动/行业，不是单架飞机；职业例句匹配。

author: root

senses.definition: a bird that hunts or a person favouring strong action
senses.example: A hawk circled above the field.

senses.definition: to sell goods loudly in public
senses.example: Vendors hawked snacks near the station.

reviewNotes: hawk 鸟类及主张强硬者双义保留，沿街兜售的动词也存在。

author: root

senses.zh: 富有想象力的；有创意的
senses.definition: good at thinking of new ideas
senses.example: The children gave imaginative answers.

reviewNotes: imaginative 是善于构想新点子；儿童创意答案例句合适。

author: root

senses.zh: 没有希望的；无能为力的；很差的
senses.definition: unlikely to succeed or very poor at something
senses.example: I felt hopeless after several failed attempts.

reviewNotes: hopeless 可指无望或某方面很差；情绪例句与后义搭配均自然。

author: root

senses.zh: 令人怜悯的；差劲得可鄙的
senses.definition: causing sympathy through suffering or earning little respect through poor effort
senses.example: His excuse was pathetic.
senses.note: 既可表同情，也常带贬义；须看上下文。

evidence.note: Dictionary separates sympathy and disapproving senses.

reviewNotes: pathetic 有令人怜悯与糟糕可鄙两种语气；中文措辞已区分。

author: root

senses.definition: to attach firmly or close so it stays in place
senses.example: Please fasten your seat belt.

reviewNotes: fasten 表示扣紧固定，不仅是系带；安全带例句高频。

author: root

senses.definition: to break down slowly or become weaker
senses.example: The old wood began to decay.

senses.definition: the process of breaking down or becoming weaker
senses.example: The dentist found early tooth decay.

reviewNotes: decay 动词腐朽与名词腐烂/衰退都常见；蛀牙搭配准确。

author: root

senses.definition: a female chicken or other female bird
senses.example: The hen laid an egg.

reviewNotes: hen 为母鸡，也可泛指某些雌鸟；产蛋例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: A strong or lasting effect on people's feelings, or a sound made stronger by vibration.
senses.example: Her story had resonance with readers.

reviewNotes: resonance 有物理共振及情感共鸣；英文定义改为覆盖两种义。

author: root

senses.definition: to keep something safe or use less so it lasts
senses.example: We should conserve water.

senses.definition: a kind of jam with whole or large pieces of fruit
senses.example: She put strawberry conserve on toast.
senses.note: 较少见的名词义；优先掌握动词“节约、保护”。

reviewNotes: conserve 动词节约/保护为主；名词整果果酱罕见，保留但标明优先级。

author: root

senses.definition: a long thin strip of food made from flour or rice
senses.example: She made noodles for lunch.
senses.note: 口语中的贬义称呼不适合作为首页义。

reviewNotes: noodle 为面条；米粉及汤面搭配可理解。

author: root

senses.definition: a game in which a ball is rolled towards pins
senses.example: We went bowling after dinner.

reviewNotes: bowling 主用法为保龄球运动；保龄球馆搭配自然。

author: root

senses.definition: for a particular purpose or person
senses.example: The cake was made specially for her birthday.

reviewNotes: specially 指为特定人或目的特意做；生日蛋糕例句合适。

author: root

senses.zh: 摇晃的；不稳固的；不确定的
senses.definition: moving slightly or not dependable
senses.example: The old chair felt shaky.

reviewNotes: shaky 可指手/物体抖动，也可指根据不可靠；两类搭配均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: able to last a long time without breaking
senses.example: This bag is made from durable material.

reviewNotes: durable 是经久耐用而非仅结实；商品搭配自然。

author: root

senses.definition: gas formed from a substance that is usually liquid or solid
senses.example: Warm air can carry water vapour.

reviewNotes: vapour 是气态物，不是窗上凝结水滴；修正物理错误例句。

author: root

senses.definition: willingness to give money, time, or help freely
senses.example: We thanked her for her generosity.

reviewNotes: generosity 包括给出时间和帮助；非仅金钱慷慨。

author: root

senses.definition: to pass powder through a sieve or examine information carefully
senses.example: Sift the flour before adding it.

reviewNotes: sift 筛粉与筛查信息均成立；through 搭配对应引申义。

author: root

senses.definition: a device for finding direction, a drawing tool, or a range
senses.example: Use a compass to find north.
senses.note: 圆规常用复数 compasses；“范围”义较正式。

reviewNotes: compass 常用名词指南针/圆规；旧版动词包围图谋过时，显式移除。

旧版动词‘包围、达到、图谋’为过时或极少见用法，现代学习卡保留常用名词。

author: root

senses.definition: the quality of being new or something unusual
senses.example: The novelty of the game soon wore off.

reviewNotes: novelty 可指新奇感及新奇小物；新鲜感消退例句正确。

author: root

senses.definition: the amount of light something gives or reflects
senses.example: Lower the screen brightness at night.

reviewNotes: brightness 指光的明亮程度；屏幕亮度例句直接。

author: root

senses.definition: the beginning of an event or period
senses.example: We agreed on the rules at the outset.

reviewNotes: outset 是开始时点，惯用 at the outset；定义与例句一致。

author: root

senses.definition: to pay money back or return help or kindness
senses.example: I will repay the loan next year.

reviewNotes: repay 偿还债务或回报善意；贷款例句示最常见义。

author: root

senses.definition: to put something important at risk
senses.example: The delay could jeopardize the project.
senses.note: 美式 jeopardize；英式也写 jeopardise。

reviewNotes: jeopardize 是使有风险而非已经破坏；项目延期例句匹配。

author: root

senses.definition: to arrange regular access to a service or pay for shares
senses.example: She subscribes to an English magazine.
senses.note: subscribe to 表示订阅或赞同；“签署”通常用 sign。

reviewNotes: subscribe to 订阅、subscribe for shares 认购股份；多义不混淆。

author: root

senses.definition: an organization for education or research
senses.example: She works at a research institute.

senses.definition: to start a rule or system officially
senses.example: The school instituted a new programme.

reviewNotes: institute 机构名词与正式推行的动词均较常用；政策例句合适。

author: root

senses.definition: to begin to grow or develop
senses.example: The seeds sprouted after the rain.

senses.definition: a new growth from a plant or an edible young shoot
senses.example: Tiny sprouts appeared in the pot.

reviewNotes: sprout 发芽动词与嫩芽名词并保留；雨后种子例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: relating to the backbone or spinal cord
senses.example: The doctor checked for a spinal injury.
senses.note: spinal 来自 spine（脊柱），不是“针的”。

evidence.note: Dictionary says relating to the spine.

reviewNotes: spinal 指脊柱或脊髓相关；伤情和 cord 搭配自然。

author: root

senses.definition: a common bird with a small head and short legs
senses.example: A pigeon landed on the balcony.

reviewNotes: pigeon 指常见鸽子；信鸽搭配是其用途。

author: root

senses.definition: to make a feeling or effect stronger
senses.example: The news heightened public concern.

reviewNotes: heighten 是使程度增强，不仅物理高度提高；公众担忧例句恰当。

author: root

senses.definition: a position north or south of the equator, or freedom to act
senses.example: The city lies at a high northern latitude.

reviewNotes: latitude 为纬度，也可指行动自由度；自由度搭配已写完整。

author: root

senses.definition: to consider two things equal or the same
senses.example: Do not equate price with quality.

reviewNotes: equate with/to 均表示视作等同；价格与质量例句对应。

author: root

senses.definition: to strongly want something for a long time
senses.example: She yearned to travel abroad.

reviewNotes: yearn 含强烈、持续的渴望；旅行目标例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: the study of how people live together in groups
senses.example: She studies sociology at university.

reviewNotes: sociology 研究人类社会群体；大学专业例句匹配。

author: root

senses.zh: 一定会…的；受约束的；开往…的
senses.definition: Certain to happen, required by duty, or travelling towards a particular place.
senses.example: It is bound to rain later.

senses.definition: a limit or a large jumping step
senses.example: The dog crossed the garden in one bound.

senses.definition: to move with long jumps or form a limit around something
senses.example: The deer bounded across the field.

reviewNotes: bound 形容词还可指开往某处；名词界限/跳跃、动词跳跃均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: to bring separate parts together into one
senses.example: The project aims to unify the two systems.

reviewNotes: unify 是将分离部分合一；两个系统整合例句恰当。

author: root

senses.definition: an open space in a forest, removing obstacles, or settling payments
senses.example: We stopped in a small forest clearing.

reviewNotes: clearing 可指林间空地、清除及银行清算；主例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: A shop that sells medicines, or the study of preparing medicines.
senses.example: You can buy the medicine at the pharmacy.

reviewNotes: pharmacy 药店与药学均常用；不强称所有药店都现场配药。

author: root

senses.definition: an increase in speed or the rate at which speed changes
senses.example: The car's acceleration surprised me.

reviewNotes: acceleration 可指速度增加或其变化率；车辆例句合适。

author: root

senses.definition: the distance between repeating parts of a wave
senses.example: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue light.

reviewNotes: wavelength 字面为波的重复部分距离；same wavelength 是观点相近习语。

author: root

senses.definition: a request for payment, paper money, a proposed law, or a bird's beak
senses.example: We paid the restaurant bill.

senses.definition: to ask someone to pay or advertise someone as a performer
senses.example: The hotel billed us for breakfast.

reviewNotes: bill 有账单、美钞、法案、鸟喙；动词收费/宣传；例句各有所指。

author: root

senses.definition: a curved line winding around a centre
senses.example: The staircase formed a spiral.

senses.definition: to move in a spiral or change quickly in an uncontrolled way
senses.example: Costs spiralled after the delay.

senses.definition: shaped like a curve around a centre
senses.example: She bought a spiral notebook.

reviewNotes: spiral 形状名词、急剧变化动词、螺旋形容词均常用；保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 清楚地；明显地；明确不同地
senses.definition: in a way that is easy to notice or understand
senses.example: I distinctly remember meeting her.

reviewNotes: distinctly 可指清晰或明显；清楚记得例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: the foot of an animal with claws or pads
senses.example: The dog put a paw on my knee.

senses.definition: to touch or scratch with a paw or hand
senses.example: The dog pawed at the door.

reviewNotes: paw 动物脚爪名词，动词用爪扒或乱摸；门口例句对应。

author: root

senses.definition: to turn or move quickly around
senses.example: The leaves whirled in the wind.

senses.definition: a rapid circular movement or confused activity
senses.example: The dance was a whirl of colour.

reviewNotes: whirl 是快速旋转或忙乱状态；叶片例句示动作。

author: root

senses.definition: having complete power to govern itself or the highest authority
senses.example: The country became a sovereign state.

senses.definition: a king or queen who rules a country
senses.example: The sovereign opened the ceremony.

reviewNotes: sovereign 形容词主权/最高权力，名词君主；国体例句恰当。

author: root

senses.definition: to move quickly and lightly back and forth
senses.example: The flag fluttered in the wind.

senses.zh: 拍翅；轻微颤动；一阵紧张
senses.definition: a quick light movement or a brief nervous feeling
senses.example: She felt a flutter of excitement.

reviewNotes: flutter 是轻快摆动/振翅，也有紧张心跳；旗帜例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: To have to pay a cost or suffer a loss because of something that happens.
senses.example: Late payments may incur a fee.

reviewNotes: incur 通常指招致费用或不利后果；改用更易懂解释。

author: root

senses.definition: to remove written or stored information
senses.example: Please delete the old file.

reviewNotes: delete 删除文字/储存信息，不等同实物销毁；文件例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: a large fire or bright light
senses.example: Firefighters put out the blaze.

senses.definition: to burn strongly or shine brightly
senses.example: The fire blazed through the night.

reviewNotes: blaze 大火或强烈光芒，动词猛烈燃烧/发光；消防例句匹配。

author: root

senses.definition: relating to how a living body's parts work
senses.example: The study measured physiological responses.

reviewNotes: physiological 指生理机能，非心理反应；研究反应例句准确。

author: root

senses.definition: a person whose job is making or repairing things from wood
senses.example: The carpenter repaired the door.

reviewNotes: carpenter 专门以木材制作修理者；修门例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: something kept to remember a place or event
senses.example: She bought a small souvenir from the museum.

reviewNotes: souvenir 为旅行/事件纪念物；博物馆例句合适。

author: root

senses.definition: following one after another without a break
senses.example: The team won three successive games.

reviewNotes: successive 表接连无间隔，与连续比赛获胜例句吻合。

author: root

senses.definition: Used to introduce an idea that is opposite to the one just mentioned.
senses.example: More exercise can improve sleep; conversely, less exercise may make sleep worse.

reviewNotes: conversely 用于相反方向的论述；原例对比关系不够反向，已修。

author: root

senses.definition: A small, usually sweet baked snack in Britain, or a soft bread roll in the US.
senses.example: She had a biscuit with her tea.
senses.note: 英式 biscuit 通常是饼干；美式 biscuit 常是松软小面包。

reviewNotes: biscuit 英式主要小烤饼干，美式为松软咸面包；标明地域。

author: root

senses.definition: a person working temporarily to gain experience or a first-year doctor in the US
senses.example: She worked as an intern at the museum.

senses.definition: to work for experience or hold someone for political or military reasons
senses.example: He interned at a local newspaper.
senses.note: 动词“拘留”常用被动；英式两种动词义的重音可能不同。

reviewNotes: intern 名词实习生及美式初年医生，动词实习/战时拘留均存在。

author: root

senses.zh: 依照；符合（用于 in accordance with）
senses.definition: Agreement with a rule or wish, especially in the phrase 'in accordance with'.
senses.example: The work was done in accordance with the plan.
senses.note: 常用固定搭配 in accordance with＝按照、符合。

reviewNotes: accordance 主要见 in accordance with，意为依照规定；释义及例句强调搭配。
